subject: Use binary representation in assert crash log, cleanup in crash log (#1410)
reason: The change is a cleanup/refactor of crash-log formatting in src/debug.c (_serverAssertPrintClientInfo and logCurrentClient), which only executes while the server is already aborting. It changes no command reply, data, replication, or persistence behavior; its only effect is the textual form of a crash report, a path no command/fault/workload scenario can reach or meaningfully compare without first inducing a crash, so there is nothing a scenario's oracles can drive or judge.
